title: Free speech group FIRE says DOJ and DHS will end efforts to curb "ICE Sightings - Chicagoland" Facebook group and Eyes Up iOS app, which report on ICE activity (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
title_en: Free speech group FIRE says DOJ and DHS will end efforts to curb "ICE Sightings - Chicagoland" Facebook group and Eyes Up iOS app, which report on ICE activity (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: WASHINGTON, Nov 13 (Reuters) - Free speech group FIRE said on Friday the US government agreed to end efforts to press Apple (AAPL.O) and Facebook (META.O) to restrict platforms created by two Americans reporting Immigration and Customs Enforcement activity.
summary_en: The U.S. government has agreed to end efforts pressuring Facebook and Apple to restrict platforms reporting on ICE immigration enforcement activity following a First Amendment settlement with free speech group FIRE.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国联邦司法部与国土安全部已正式与言论自由组织FIRE签署和解协议，永久停止游说并施压Apple与Meta下架追踪ICE联邦移民执法的数字工具。联邦法院法官裁定政府不得以任何形式干涉此类公民监督平台，确立了数字时代公共执法监督受第一修正案保护的重要判例。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The U.S. DOJ and DHS settled a First Amendment lawsuit with free speech group FIRE, agreeing to permanently halt efforts coercing Apple and Meta to censor tools tracking ICE activity. The court ruling protects citizen documentation of federal law enforcement under constitutional free speech guarantees.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】美国联邦司法部与国土安全部已正式与言论自由组织FIRE签署和解协议，永久停止游说并施压Apple与Meta下架追踪ICE联邦移民执法的数字工具。
【核心事实细节】联邦法院法官裁定政府不得以任何形式干涉此类公民监督平台，确立了数字时代公共执法监督受第一修正案保护的重要判例。
【各方立场与态度】该案确立了关键的数字言论自由红线：政府不得通过对应用商店和社交平台进行幕后施压来变相审查民间对联邦执法行为的监督与记录。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] DOJ and DHS settled a First Amendment lawsuit with free speech group FIRE, agreeing to permanently halt efforts coercing Apple and Meta to censor tools tracking ICE activity.

title: US officials say Trump is not expected to raise allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation involving Jensen Huang during his upcoming meeting with Xi (Dan Mangan/CNBC)
title_en: US officials say Trump is not expected to raise allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation involving Jensen Huang during his upcoming meeting with Xi (Dan Mangan/CNBC)
author: CNBC
content_snippet:
President Donald Trump is not expected to raise allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang during his upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, senior U.S. officials said Friday.

Officials also said that Elon Musk, the CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, will accompany Trump on the trip to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit on Nov. 18 and 19.

The White House, earlier Friday, said Trump plans to have a three-way summit
summary_en: Senior U.S. officials stated that President Donald Trump is not expected to raise allegations involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and his alleged ties to a cloud-computing company suspected of bypassing chip export controls during his upcoming China visit. title: Tesla Says It’s Starting to Sell Cybercabs for Personal Use

author: Kara Carlson
content_snippet: Tesla Inc. invited select customers to place orders for the Cybercab in a step toward trying to make its driverless car available to consumers.

title: Doc: Amazon, wary of AI agents favoring sites with better data, plans to gather data on nearly every product sold anywhere, including by crawling rivals' sites (Greg Bensinger/Reuters)
title_en: Doc: Amazon, wary of AI agents favoring sites with better data, plans to gather data on nearly every product sold anywhere, including by crawling rivals' sites (Greg Bensinger/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: Amazon (AMZN.O) has a secret plan to ensure shoppers never need to leave its site: own the world's product information.
summary_en: Amazon is developing the 'World Product Graph' project, which plans to crawl competitor websites to index virtually every product sold online. The strategy aims to feed massive data into the Alexa AI shopping assistant, improving response accuracy and ensuring that consumers remain within the Amazon ecosystem even during research phases.

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Amazon is developing the 'World Product Graph' project, which plans to crawl competitor websites to index virtually every product sold online. 【起因与机理】应对AI搜索趋势，通过垄断数据源提升Alexa使用黏性与转化率
【核心事实细节】亚马逊秘密规划全网电商数据抓取项目。

title: Sources: the FAA outage occurred after an update to the private communications network that connects the ATC system caused the system to reboot and crash (Kierra Frazier/CBS News)

author: CBS News
content_snippet:
A rare nationwide ground stop on all departing U.S. flights that lasted several hours Friday has been lifted, and flights are resuming, the Federal Aviation Administration said. Officials said the issue stemmed from a "telecommunication outage."

summary_en: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that the nationwide FAA ground stop was caused by a system crash triggered by an update to the aging air traffic control communications network. content_snippet:
AI researcher Will DePue says a forensic analysis has turned up the first technical evidence that leading Chinese AI labs have access to Nvidia's latest Blackwell hardware despite US export controls. He says senior researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic have already checked the method.

According to a forensic investigation by Will DePue, Chinese AI companies DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group are using Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell GPUs. DePue played a key role at OpenAI in build
summary_en: Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue identified specific compute core signatures of Nvidia’s Blackwell architecture within recent models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group. By tracing weight initialization patterns linked to specific GPU core counts (148/152 for Blackwell), the analysis, verified by OpenAI and Anthropic researchers, provides evidence of circumvented US export controls.

title: Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed and on track to become the largest public offering in history
title_en: Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed and on track to become the largest public offering in history
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Anthropic is on track for the largest IPO ever, with orders exceeding available shares by a factor of six. That's according to Bloomberg. The Claude developer and its co-founders aim to raise up to $64.4 billion through the public offering and another $26 billion via a private placement, which would surpass even SpaceX's IPO. The target valuation sits at roughly $1.4 trillion, with existing investors getting priority in share allocation.

The company's financials likely fuel much of the demand.

content_snippet:

COP31 officially kicked off on November 8, marking the beginning of negotiations on one of the biggest stages of the climate world. Turkey and Australia are cohosting this year’s talks, which are scheduled to wrap up on November 20.
